response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
